provenance: The compose document is committed in this repository and pairs the official EHRbase image with its own PostgreSQL image, the upstream quickstart pairing. The Basic-auth pair is the image's own default, which this repository's browser journeys drive first-hand. The topology declares one clinical principal and the unauthenticated one, so every case addressing an admin or read-only principal is recorded not-applicable at selection time rather than driven under the wrong identity.
